name: Ono no Takamura
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 11); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 852.

poems.title: Oh! Fishers in your little boats
poems.author: Ono no Takamura
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 11
poems.text:
Oh! Fishers in your little boats,
Quick! tell my men, I pray,
They’ll find me at Yasoshima,
I’m being rowed away
Far off across the bay.

poems.title: 11. わたの原 八十島かけて 漕ぎ出でぬと (Wata no hara yaso shima kakete kogiidenu to)
poems.author: Ono no Takamura
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
わたの原 八十島かけて 漕ぎ出でぬと
人にはつげよ あまの釣舟
